content.text: Remove the two center support bolts.
After removing one bolt, the other one will be loose.

content.description: Illustration showing location of center support bolts in transmission assembly with two bolt locations indicated

content.text: 30. REMOVE CENTER SUPPORT AND SUN GEAR ASSEMBLY
From the case front opening, grasp the assembly and pull it out. Watch for the bearing race on the end of the sun gear.

content.description: Illustration showing removal of center support and sun gear assembly from case opening, with gear assembly visible

content.text: Using a long screwdriver, compress the snap ring and lift it above the groove with a wire hook.

content.description: Illustration showing use of screwdriver to compress and remove snap ring from reaction plate

content.text: Grasp the intermediate shaft and pull out the rear parts group.
Make sure apply tube and rear thrust bearing and races do not come out with the assembly, remove them from the case.
Watch for the bearing and race in the transmission case.

content.description: Illustration showing removal of rear parts group by grasping intermediate shaft and pulling assembly out

content.text: The transmission in now in basic component subassemblies. Next, disassemble, clean, inspect, repair and assemble each of these component groups.
